name: The Casa, Macao, in the gardens of which is Camoens' Cave (the residence of Lady Pereira), Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view of the gardens in which the Portuguese poet Luís de Camões is said to have composed part of his epic work 'Os Lusíadas'; the small pavilion built above the 'Grotto of  Camões' can be seen emerging from the trees above 'the Casa', a large house rented by the Pereira family to the East India Co

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
